svg.title: Three places to store partial sums between K-blocks
svg.desc: Each K-block produces partial sums. The result array places the tile's columns far apart, so direct updates would read, add, and write across those gaps on every block. The full output matrix keeps each microtile together but uses about 648 megabytes. A compact scratch tile per thread also keeps values together and uses about 280 kilobytes per thread.
svg.text: where do partial sums wait between K-blocks?
